description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet called StayedLockedLoansTasklet. It retrieves loan account data that has remained locked for a certain period and triggers an event if such accounts are found.

classes.name: StayedLockedLoansTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch tasklet that processes loan accounts that have remained locked and emits a business event if such accounts are found.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point for the tasklet, executes the logic to fetch and notify about locked loans.

methods.name: buildLoanAccountData
methods.description: Helper method that builds the data object containing all stayed locked loans for the current business date.
